name: Dangerous Horse Riding
desc:
🐎 Dangerous Horse Riding
The trail is wild—ride at your own risk! 🌄 Can you reach the goal? 🏁

⚠️ Watch out:

Steep cliffs ⛰️
Narrow paths 🐾
Armed riders ahead! 🔫🐎
Don’t lose your balance—fight and ride! 💥
Can you reach the finish line to win?

👍 Like the game for updates!

🧪 Still in beta—expect bugs and updates!
